title: Create OpenCode agent definitions for Ralph workflow
description: Create .opencode/agent/ralph.md (primary agent that loads ralph skill) and .opencode/agent/ralph-worker.md (hidden subagent for single story implementation). Configure proper tool permissions and agent modes. Test agent spawning and context isolation.

title: TDD: Demonstrate Ralph skill is installable
description: Write a TDD test that demonstrates Ralph as a skill is installable. The test should verify that Ralph skill files can be copied to a target project and are usable. Follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR methodology. Test should initially fail (RED) for missing functionality, then we implement the skill installation mechanism, then test passes (GREEN).
close_reason: TDD tests created and passing. Tests verify Ralph skill installation and basic invocation setup.

title: Implement Agent-Based Ralph Loop for OpenCode
description: Replace bash script with native OpenCode agents for better integration and cleaner architecture

title: Update /ralph-run command to use agent-based loop
description: Modify existing /ralph-run OpenCode command to launch ralph-orchestrator agent instead of bash script. Maintain backward compatibility options.

title: Create OpenCode skill for Ralph loop
description: Create .opencode/skill/ralph/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter and structured instructions. Convert prompt.md logic to skill format. Include completion detection and safeguard logic. Test skill loading and basic invocation.

title: TDD for Ralph loop core logic modules
description: Create Python modules for PRD story processing, completion detection, progress tracking, and branch management. Implement ralph.core module with pure functions.

title: TDD: Demonstrate installed Ralph skills support basic invocation of the Ralph loop
description: Write a TDD test that demonstrates installed Ralph skills support basic invocation of the Ralph loop. The test should verify that after installing Ralph skill, a basic invocation (e.g., running ralph.sh with minimal PRD) works correctly. Follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR methodology. Test should initially fail (RED) for missing functionality, then we implement the skill invocation mechanism, then test passes (GREEN).
close_reason: TDD tests created and passing. Tests verify Ralph skill installation and basic invocation setup.

title: Ensure backward compatibility for existing Ralph scripts
description: Maintain ralph.sh as wrapper or provide migration path. Update ralph-loop.sh and installation scripts to support both workflows.

title: Test agent-based Ralph loop integration
description: Create integration tests verifying agent-based loop works equivalently to bash script. Test clean context per worker, COMPLETE signal detection, and error handling.

title: Research OpenCode agent capabilities for Ralph loop
description: Investigate Task tool behavior, agent context isolation, and loop orchestration patterns in OpenCode. Determine if subagents get clean context and how orchestrator can wait for completion.
close_reason: Research completed: Task tool waits for subagent completion; subagents have clean context per invocation; filesystem persists; orchestrator-worker pattern feasible. Findings documented in PRD US-002.

title: Update documentation for agent-based Ralph workflow
description: Update AGENTS.md and README.md with new agent-based workflow instructions. Document differences from bash script approach and migration path.
